D: Three lifelong friends spend one last wild Christmas Eve in New York hunting for a legendary party.
P: Serve the snacks when they head out into New York on Christmas Eve.
S: Mini bagels with chive cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill

Toasted mini bagels spread with chive cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers, red onion and fresh dill. Split 12 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half. Top with a ribbon of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers, a sliver of red onion and a sprig of dill. Finish with cracked black pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.
Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wings
Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce, butter and honey

Crisp oven-baked wings tossed in buttery hot sauce with a cool ranch dip, carrot and celery sticks. Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry and toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey, then toss the wings through. For the ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp buttermilk, chopped chives and dill and garlic powder. Serve with carrot and celery sticks.
M: Sliders and mac and cheese party plate
Cheeseburger sliders with pickles and baked mac and cheese cups
Little beef sliders and mac and cheese cups, the kind of party food you would hope to find at the most famous party in town.
W: Sticky ginger and golden syrup cake
Soft sticky gingerbread cake with lemon icing, something sweet for when the night finally winds down.
K: Red wine simmered with orange, honey, cinnamon, star anise and clove

Red wine gently warmed with orange, cinnamon, star anise and cloves, sweetened with honey and served steaming in mugs with an orange slice. Pour 750ml red wine into a saucepan with 250ml orange juice, 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise, 6 cloves and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes, keeping it below a simmer so the alcohol stays. Ladle into 4 mugs with an orange slice each. For anyone not drinking, warm sparkling apple juice with the same spices.

steps.text: Toss the beetroot slices with the juice of one lemon, the olive oil, smoked paprika and a pinch of salt and leave to soak.
Split the bagels and toast until golden.
Beat the cream cheese with the chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half.

dishes.n: Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wings
dishes.make_ahead: Toss the wings with the baking powder and salt up to 1 day ahead, uncovered in the fridge, and make the ranch up to 3 days ahead; bake and sauce the wings on the night

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings through.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, chopped chives, chopped dill and garlic powder for the ranch.

veg.n: Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo cauliflower
veg.make_ahead: Make the ranch up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; batter, bake and sauce the cauliflower on the night so it stays crisp

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, baking powder, salt and half the garlic powder into a batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey, toss the cauliflower through and bake a few minutes more.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, chopped chives, chopped dill and the rest of the garlic powder for the ranch.
Serve with the ranch and carrot and celery sticks.

dishes.n: Sliders and mac and cheese party plate
dishes.make_ahead: Bake the mac and cheese cups up to 1 day ahead and reheat at 180C; shape and cook the patties on the night

steps.text: Cook the macaroni until just tender and drain.
Mix the macaroni with the cheese and milk and spoon into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Shape the mince into small patties and cook on both sides, topping with the cheddar slices to melt.
Serve in slider buns with pickles alongside the mac and cheese cups.
